items.description: The Grand Mosque of Brazzaville is a major religious landmark in the capital. Its size and minarets make it a prominent part of the city skyline.
Pointe-Noire Railway Station is the western rail terminus of the CFCO line. It connects the port city to the rest of the country by rail.
The People's Palace in Brazzaville is a large public building used for state and institutional events. It is one of the capital's best-known official landmarks.
Maya-Maya Airport Terminal is the main air gateway to Brazzaville. It handles domestic and international traffic for the capital.
Total Tower Pointe-Noire is a modern office tower linked to the city's energy sector. It is part of the contemporary skyline of the port city.
Talangaï Viaduct is an important road structure in northern Brazzaville. It helps traffic move through one of the capital's busiest districts.
Freedom Monument Brazzaville is a public monument associated with independence and civic identity. It stands as one of the city's symbolic landmarks.
